Binary name `rvr` chosen 2026-05-06 for Reverie. Rejected alternatives recorded so future audits don't redo the work.

REJECTED:
- `rev` — collides with util-linux `rev` (Unix command that reverses lines). Hard collision, blocks installation on every Linux system.
- `re` — too overloaded. Email "Re:", Python re module culturally, likely binary on some systems. High collision risk.
- `rv` — npm package taken (Rich Harris's abandoned Ractive RequireJS plugin from 2024) AND active Homebrew formula (Spinel Co-op Ruby version manager, ~1700 installs/year, already conflicts with `rv-r`). Three competing tools in that namespace = hard pass.

CHOSEN:
- `rvr` — Homebrew clean. NPM `rvr` taken by abandoned aviation tool (FAA Runway Visual Range, no recent activity), but bare-name collision sidestepped via scoped @seabear/reverie package with `bin: { "rvr": "..." }`. Standard pattern (gh, pnpm — binary name independent of package name). Tradeoff: `npx rvr` won't work; `npx @seabear/reverie` does. Acceptable since user's primary install paths are GitHub binary download + Homebrew, with npm tertiary.

FALLBACK IF `rvr` BECOMES CONTESTED:
- `revr` (4 chars, more readable)
